reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000301 (the melody read from 000301a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 2 notes off in 19); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Ludwig von Beethoven's dates (1770–1827) are from our page for the tune HYMN TO JOY (content/hymns/tunes/hymn-to-joy.json); CCEH's page gives none. William Gardiner's dates (1770–1853) are from our page for the tune BELMONT (content/hymns/tunes/belmont.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1815. The page gives no year for the tune itself; it was in print by 1815, the year of the arrangement. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000301a.nwc).
